name: Is surface preparation included in the full interior paint package?

mainEntity.name: Is surface preparation included in the full interior paint package?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, thorough surface preparation is a critical component of our full interior paint packages. This includes essential steps such as cleaning the walls, filling small holes and cracks, sanding rough areas, and light drywall patching as needed. Proper preparation ensures optimal paint adhesion, a smooth finish, and the longevity of your new paint job. More extensive repairs, such as large drywall damage, may be quoted separately.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, surface preparation, including cleaning, patching small holes, filling cracks, and sanding, is included in our full interior paint package.
